name: cadre-lifecycle-gitlab
description: GitLab-flavored Agentic SDLC gate-approval recording: a conversational skill that records lifecycle gate decisions from a real GitLab MR approval via approve-from-gitlab/approve-from-gitlab-mr. Requires cadre-lifecycle-core to also be installed. If you don't have a GitLab approval to cite, cadre-lifecycle-core's generic lifecycle-review skill covers that case.
